status_vocabulary.guaranteed: a published fabrication or laminate specification limit or tolerance
status_vocabulary.typical: a laminate vendor's typical value, never a tolerance
status_vocabulary.nominal: a value a design tool or a fabricator's calculator uses
status_vocabulary.assumed: an engineering assumption made in decision 0009
status_vocabulary.unbounded: tolerances only: no source bounds it, and no number is guessed

copper.designation: electrodeposited copper, foil type not published by the fabricator

conductivity.note: annealed copper standard; plated and foil copper may be lower, which enters the bounded loss study

fr4_prepreg_7628.designation: 7628 glass prepreg, resin content 49 per cent, in the fabricator's NP-155F based stack-up; brand not guaranteed per order

permittivity.method: fabricator impedance calculator value, no frequency stated

loss_tangent.note: middle of 0.014 to 0.016 quoted for NP-155F 0.062 inch laminate at 1 GHz; nothing published at 2.44 GHz

fr4_core_np155f.designation: NP-155F core assumed by the fabricator's calculator

permittivity.method: fabricator impedance calculator value, no frequency stated
permittivity.note: V9 gives 4.43 for NP-155F cores above 0.70 mm; the conflict is recorded, and no RF trace references this core

fr4_two_layer.designation: two layer FR-4 core; brand not fixed by the fabricator, one of NP-140F, KB-6164, S1141 or S1000H (V14)

permittivity.method: fabricator capability page value for two layer boards, no frequency stated

loss_tangent.note: no value published for the two layer laminate; taken equal to the NP-155F figure at 1 GHz, and Kingboard KB6167F gives 0.014 at 2 GHz

beamformer.board: RF beamformer and control interface board

fabrication.process: 4 layer FR-4, 1.6 mm, controlled impedance stack-up JLC04161H-7628
fabrication.service_tier: standard multilayer; impedance control at no extra charge (V8); impedance tolerance stated as 10 per cent on V11 and 20 per cent for the free tier on V10, a conflict to settle at order time
fabrication.ordering_notes: order with impedance control so that the published stack-up is used; declare the RF nets as uncoated microstrip and confirm that RF widths are not adjusted for a coated model
fabrication.lead_time: 2 to 5 days for 5 pieces up to 100 x 100 mm, V16
fabrication.cost_class: low; no quote obtained, the instant quote needs a browser; boards up to 102 x 102 mm are priced specially

layers.name: L1
layers.role: RF microstrip, RF components, local escapes outside RF keep-out

thickness.note: finished outer copper, V10 says stack-up copper is finished copper

layers.name: L2
layers.role: continuous RF reference plane, no routing, no splits

layers.name: L3
layers.role: power rails and slow digital: beam state lines, strobe, I2C, converter

layers.name: L4
layers.role: digital and connector routing, ground pour stitched to L2

beamformer.rf_keepout: L2 continuous beneath every RF trace, divider and switch, with at least three PP1 thicknesses of plane either side; vias through L2 there are ground stitching only; a signal on L3 or L4 crossing beneath an RF trace is shielded by L2 and may not change reference layer there

surface_finish.detail: nickel about 3 to 6 um, V13; gold 1 or 2 microinch, V11

fabrication.process: 2 layer FR-4, 1.6 mm, 1 oz finished copper
fabrication.service_tier: standard two layer; controlled impedance is not offered on two layer boards (V11)
fabrication.ordering_notes: laminate brand not fixed; record the material reported with the order
fabrication.lead_time: about 1 to 2 days for small quantities up to 100 x 100 mm, V16; this board is larger
fabrication.cost_class: low; no quote obtained; above the 102 x 102 mm special price and below the 650 square centimetre surcharge

thickness.note: 1.6 mm finished board less two 0.035 mm copper layers; the core thickness is not published

layers.name: L2
layers.role: continuous ground under every patch and feed, no routing

antenna.rf_keepout: the board is passive; L2 is one unbroken ground

soldermask.over_rf_microstrip: opened over patches and feed lines

rf_dielectric_thickness.basis: the published finished board tolerance, 10 per cent for boards of 1.0 mm and above, applied to the L1 to L2 prepreg; no prepreg tolerance is published

rf_dielectric_permittivity.basis: envelope of published values for 7628 rich FR-4 from brands the fabricator names: NP-155F 4.2 to 4.4 at 1 GHz (V12), KB6167F 4.6 at 2 GHz (V15), calculator 4.4 (V8)
rf_dielectric_permittivity.note: not a guarantee; the coupon extraction is the authority once a board exists

rf_copper_thickness.basis: the fabricator publishes 0.035 mm on its stack-up page and 1.6 mil, 0.0406 mm, in its calculator; no copper tolerance is published

rf_dielectric_thickness.basis: the published finished board tolerance applied to the core, which is nearly the whole board

rf_dielectric_permittivity.basis: envelope of NP-155F 4.2 to 4.4 at 1 GHz (V12), KB6167F 4.6 at 2 GHz (V15) and the 4.5 the fabricator states (V11)
rf_dielectric_permittivity.note: data for NP-140F, KB-6164, S1141 and S1000H were not retrieved; the patch resonance measured on the board is the authority

rf_copper_thickness.note: no copper tolerance is published; bounded by cross section only if SIM shows the antenna sensitive to it

dielectric_dispersion.note: each permittivity and loss tangent is used as given; no source gives these laminates at 2.44 GHz

copper_roughness.note: no fabricator roughness data; conductor loss is bounded between smooth and the Hammerstad and Jensen asymptote of twice smooth; no roughness parameter is asserted, and the apparent permittivity rise of rough foil is left to the coupon extraction

soldermask_on_rf.note: follows the fabrication rule that mask is opened over RF microstrip; checked by inspection of the fabricated board

surface_finish_on_rf.note: ENIG nickel adds conductor loss; it enters the bounded loss study and the coupon attenuation extraction

reference_plane.model: finite conductivity boundary at the copper conductivity
reference_plane.note: the 15.2 um inner copper is about eleven skin depths thick at f0, so its thickness is not modelled
